breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t) = 0 and u(1,t) = 0', thus resolving the inconsistency.
